question: Under what condition does determinate cognition arise in the bound soul?
premises: Determinate cognition takes the form 'I know this in this way.'
Such cognition arises through reflection conditioned by the six sheaths.
This reflection emerges from the limited atomic self.
inference: Therefore determinate cognition arises when the limited self reflects experience through the six sheaths.
uncertainties: ṣaṭkañcukā refers to the six coverings; left as six sheaths for doctrinal clarity.
plain_english: When, through reflection arising from the limited self within the cavity of the six sheaths, there arises a determining cognition of the form 'I know this in this way'—
